title: Mother's guitar playing and family string sessions
summary: His mother sang and played guitar well; the family played string instruments together at home, starting with Under the Double Eagle.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did anyone else in your family, that is, were there any uncles, the older members, your mother play anything or did she sing?
Oh, yes, Bill. My mother used to sing and she was a good, good guitar player.
Your mother was a guitar player?

My mother gave me a lot of chords on guitars. Oh, really? Yeah, she really was a good guitar player. Yeah, she really was a good guitar player. Mm-hmm. The fact about it, Bill, we all used to get in the kitchen or the bedroom, my two brothers, my father and my mother, and get to get all string instruments and play. Oh, my. And I remember this is good, playing guitar then. The first number I was, they learned me was under the double eagle. So many changes, it was really good too, to hear all them string instruments play them together. It really was good.
